description: Score history of one LLM on AI Stupid Level: each benchmark run in the window with its score, plus the newest run's per-axis results (correctness, code quality, efficiency, …). Use it to see whether a model got better or worse over time.

max_points.description: How many runs to list, newest first (default 30). The summary always covers every run.

model.description: The model: its numeric id, its name (for example claude-opus-5-5 or gpt-6-sol) or its display name. get_leaderboard lists the tracked models with their ids.

period.description: Score window: 24h, 7d or 1m (30-day) averages, or latest (the newest run). Omit it to use the key's default: 24h on a free Data API key, latest on a paid one. latest needs a paid key.

name: get_model_history
title: Model score history
